channel.title: CrimeTimeSnacks Blog
channel.description: True crime case updates, analysis, and the stories behind the headlines.

item.title: When the Case File Gets It Wrong
item.description: The Innocence Project has helped exonerate more than 200 people convicted of serious crimes. Here's what the record shows about how it happens.

item.title: How Familial DNA Searching Actually Works
item.description: It's not magic. It's probability, patience, and a whole lot of investigative follow-up. Let's unpack what the case file really shows.

item.title: What Actually Gets a Cold Case Reopened
item.description: It's not a tip line call or a true crime podcast. The decision to reopen a case comes down to something much more specific.

item.title: What You Saw and What Happened Are Not the Same Thing
item.description: Eyewitness testimony feels like the gold standard in court. The case file shows it's one of the most fragile kinds of evidence we have.

item.title: Why Solid Evidence Gets Thrown Out of Court
item.description: The evidence looked airtight. Then a judge tossed it. Here's what chain of custody actually means for a case.

item.title: How Forensic Genealogy Is Reopening Cases the System Had Written Off
item.description: A DNA sample that sat in an evidence freezer for decades can now build a family tree. Here's what the record shows.

item.title: JonBenét Ramsey: Why the Case Stays Open
item.description: Nearly thirty years on, the 1996 killing of six-year-old JonBenét Ramsey is still unsolved. A look at why, and what modern DNA testing might still offer.

item.title: Wilmington DMV: What We Know So Far
item.description: Separating the verified facts from the speculation that filled the first hours after the December 23 incident at the Wilmington DMV.

item.title: The Watts Family Case: Reading the Warning Signs
item.description: The 2018 Watts family killings unsettled people partly because of how ordinary the family appeared. A measured look at the timeline and the confession.

item.title: Courtney Clenney: The Case Explained
item.description: A case that turns on a single, contested question the court will have to weigh. Here is the framework, without taking sides before a verdict.

item.title: Bryan Kohberger: From Arrest to Courtroom
item.description: The path from a late-night arrest to the courtroom in the University of Idaho murders case, and the evidence that drew the most attention.

item.title: The Menendez Resentencing, Explained
item.description: More than three decades after their conviction, the legal path that has put Lyle and Erik Menendez back in the headlines.

item.title: Delphi: From 'Bridge Guy' to Trial
item.description: How a few seconds of audio and a grainy image kept the Abigail Williams and Liberty German case alive for years.

item.title: How Genetic Genealogy Is Changing Cold Cases
item.description: The technique that helped identify a suspect in the Idaho student murders is reshaping how long-dormant cases get solved.
